'''Garuk''' was a [[Tasari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who led a secret cult on [[Tasariq]] that worshipped [[Tasar crystal]]s. Raised in the cult, Garuk led his cultist through the ancient rites and blood rituals and professed to shun the influence of off-worlders and believed that no Tasari should ever leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. However, while Garuk led the cult, he did not follow their tenets and had a taste for both the luxury that could only be provided by off-world technology.<ref name="J15" />

Telling his followers that he had to commune with the wilderness, Garuk would often go to a suite he maintained at the [[Imperial Hotel (Tasariq)|Imperial Hotel]] in [[Tasariq City]]. To fund this lavish lifestyle, Garuk sold the cult's Tasar crystals. As he was the only one allow inside the sacred inner sanctum, Garuk kept his crimes hidden from the cult.<ref name="J15" />

Garuk wore a golden amulet inset with three [[tasar crystal]]s; [[Citrine crystal|citrine]], [[Peridot crystal|peridot]], and [[Bloodstone crystal|bloodstone]]. He also had a ceremonial headband with a [[jasper crystal]], and a bracelet on his left arm fitted with a [[Tiger's Eye crystal]].<ref name="J15" />
